Draft.body: A manual order not submitted yet. Nothing is sent until you Submit.

To Fulfill.body: Waiting to go to the warehouse. "Sends at …" counts down the partner's delay (a Shopify order waits so the customer can still change it). "This partner sends by hand": use Send 940 now.

Sent.body: The 940 is with the warehouse; waiting for its 997 to accept it. To stop it now, ask the warehouse to cancel the 940: Cancel order opens once no 997 comes in time (997 Timeout). Don't Send 940 now meanwhile.

Fulfilling.body: The warehouse accepted it and is picking; waiting for the 945. A Shopify order is already fulfilled and archived in Shopify; the 945 adds the tracking and tells the customer. "Writing the tracking to Shopify": the 945 arrived and the tracking is being written.

Shipped.body: Invoiced partners only: the 945 arrived. Confirm delivery when it is due; that makes the invoice.

To Invoice.body: Delivery confirmed; the invoice is ready to send or queued.

Completed.body: Nothing left to do. A partner without invoicing comes here straight after the 945.

On Hold.body: Stopped until someone acts; the reason says why.

Needs Review.body: Something doesn't match the Item Master (an item, a unit, a partner code, a DC route). Fix it there, then Re-check.

Payment Required.body: Shopify hasn't reported it paid. It goes on by itself once paid; nothing to do unless the payment never comes.

Archived in Shopify.body: Archived in Shopify before it was sent. Un-archive it in Shopify to send it; leave it if the archive was intended.

940 Rejected.body: The warehouse's 997 rejected the 940. Fix the cause, then Send 940 now.

940 Failed.body: The 940 couldn't be sent (connection or file). Send 940 now once fixed.

997 Timeout.body: No 997 from the warehouse in time. Check with the warehouse: Send 940 now sends it again; if the order should not go (refunded, or the warehouse cancelled it), Cancel order with the reason.

Cancelled at Source.body: Cancelled by the customer or in Shopify after the 940 reached the warehouse. Check with the warehouse, then Release hold: Cancel the order, Mark as shipped (if a 945 came), or Back to the status it held.

945 Conflict.body: Two 945s for this order. Compare the 945s: add the second (Apply the missing part, or Apply, more than ordered), Keep the applied 945, or Cancel the order. Its task says why it was not added.

Shopify Update Failed.body: Writing to Shopify failed. Retry it on the shipment: Shipments & lots → Retry in Shopify.

Invoice Failed.body: Sending the invoice failed. Open the invoice; fix it with Edit invoice if needed, then Send.

Invoice Blocked.body: The invoice is on hold; its task says why. Open the invoice, Edit invoice if needed, then Release.

Sends.body: When the 940 goes to the warehouse by itself, after the partner's delay.

Delivery due.body: The requested delivery date (for DC-routed partners, the do-not-deliver-after date). Confirm delivery once it has been delivered; past this date it shows as late.

Short shipped.body: The 945 shipped less than ordered. Backordered = ordered − shipped (EA); no second 940 asks for the rest. A later 945 of a Shopify order that brings it is added by itself.

Over shipped.body: The 945s shipped more than the 940 carried: how many EA more, over the order's lines.

Shipments.body: How many 945s of this order count: what they shipped is added up. A resend, or one that was kept and not applied, is not counted.

Not settled.body: Finance hasn't marked the money received yet. A finance user uses Mark settled with the date it came and a reference (bank, cheque or remittance no.).

Due.body: Invoiced; the terms (Net N days from the invoice date) are not up yet. Mark settled when the money comes.

Overdue.body: Invoiced and past its terms (the invoice date + Net N days). Follow up with the partner; Mark settled when the money comes.

Settled.body: The money came. Settled (auto): a Shopify order whose payments are in a gateway settlement (named on the order). Otherwise Finance marked it, with the date and reference; Undo settled (with a reason) undoes only that mark.

Waiting for the gateway.body: Shopify order: its payments are with the gateway (Authorize.Net, or in the PayPal balance) but in no settlement yet. It becomes Settled (auto) by itself; nothing to do.

Not needed.body: No money is expected: cancelled and never invoiced, a Shopify order with nothing left to receive (fully refunded or free), or an old (historical) order whose gateway does not say Settled.

850.body: A retailer's purchase order, received through TrueCommerce. It becomes an order here.

940.body: Our shipping order to the warehouse (Radiant): what to pick and where to send it.

997.body: The warehouse's receipt for a 940 or a 943: accepted or rejected.

945.body: The warehouse's shipping report (the packing list): what left, which lots, pallets and tracking.

943.body: Our notice to the warehouse that stock is on its way to it (a transfer).

944.body: The warehouse's receipt of a transfer, or of goods a customer sent back (an RA 944).

810.body: The invoice sent to a retailer through TrueCommerce.

Order ref.body: The partner's short code, "-", and its order number (a manual order: Sales' internal number). Set when the order is made; never changes.

Internal no..body: Sales' own running number for the order.

Customer PO / reference.body: The customer's own number for the order.

Reason.body: Why a manual order was made: Gift, Replacement, Sample, Staff purchase, Phone order, Other (the list is set under Orders → Manual order settings). Chosen before it is submitted; Orders → Manual orders by reason lists them by month and reason.

Payment.body: Whether the money for the order came, beside its Status: Not settled, Due / Overdue (invoiced, Net N terms), Waiting for the gateway (Shopify), Settled (by Finance, or auto: in a gateway settlement) or Not needed. Orders → To settle lists what is open. It does not change the Status.

EA.body: Each: the unit everything is counted in. Every other unit (CS…) has its EA factor per item in the Item Master.

Delay.body: How long a partner's orders wait before the 940 goes: from receipt (invoiced partners) or from payment (prepaid). No delay: on the next run.

Invoice price.body: The invoice uses the PO price unless you set an invoice price: on the order (Edit invoice prices) before the invoice is drafted, then on the invoice (Edit invoice).

Lot / Expiry.body: The production lot and its expiry date, from the 945.

Backordered.body: Ordered − shipped (EA). No second 940 asks for the rest; a later 945 of a Shopify order that brings it is added.

On hand.body: At the warehouse now: received + returned − shipped ± adjustments.

On hold.body: Held by the warehouse, as its latest stock report says.

In process.body: By item: EA on 940s that went out with no 945 yet. By lot: what the warehouse's latest report shows picked for orders not shipped yet.

Available.body: On hand − on hold − in process.

In transit to Radiant.body: Sent on 943s and not received yet. Below zero: received but never sent (check it).

Returns on the way.body: Sent back by customers, not at the warehouse yet. Below zero: received with no return recorded.

In transit to customers.body: Shipped on a 945, delivery not final yet. It leaves this figure once the invoice is queued or sent, or straight away for an order with no invoice.

Report difference.body: Sales − the warehouse, at its latest applied stock report.

Sales, Refunds, Net.body: Successful transactions only: payments, refunds, and payments − refunds.

Gateway transaction ID.body: The payment provider's own ID. Authorize.Net payments since Sep 18, 2025 have none in Shopify: it comes from Authorize.Net once the payment is matched there.

Settlement.body: A deposit the payment provider paid to the bank: for Authorize.Net, one settled batch, about one a day; for PayPal, one transfer to the bank, with everything since the previous one (what has not been transferred yet is the In PayPal balance row). The payments in it are the money in that deposit.

Matched by.body: How the provider's transaction was found to be this Shopify payment: its transaction ID, the Shopify payment ID, the order number, or only the same amount and time (probable: check it).

Difference.body: The deposit's sales − refunds − the Shopify payments matched to it (fees aside). Not zero: some money in the deposit is no Shopify payment, or a transaction is not matched yet.

Carried balance.body: PayPal: what went to the bank − the period's net after fees. Not zero when the transfer took only part of the balance (or more, from before), a hold kept money back, or a deposit from the bank funded refunds: Other events says which.
